metadata.name: Reference Web Application
metadata.description: Full-stack serverless web application: CloudFront + S3 static hosting, WAFv2, API Gateway REST API, Lambda, DynamoDB, and Cognito authentication. Derived from aws-cloudformation-templates Solutions/WebApp (Apache-2.0) and normalized as a substrate reference pattern.

templates.description: Complete reference web application (single-stack). Suitable as a working baseline; split into bundle stacks for independent lifecycle management.

AppName.description: Name prefix for all resources in this stack

LambdaCodeS3Bucket.description: S3 bucket containing Lambda deployment packages

LambdaCodeS3Key.description: S3 object key for the API handler Lambda package
